reverse_method: consensus_net->pbt via consensus_net_profit / (1 - effective_tax_rate); op via pbt + finance - non_operating_net
source_note: Consensus reverse engineering: implied RASK/CASK use the A-share consensus FY2026 revenue and net profit stepped back through the tax and below-operating anchors, divided by the model's FY2026 ASK.  Implied values are what Street revenue/profit implies under our ASK, not Street's own RASK/CASK.  Anchors missing -> blank.
